What Makes Me Interact With Advertisements?

Purpose:

This report looks at the types of advertisements observed across various platforms and the interactions with them.

Each observation represents a single advertisement I observed online, including information about the platform, advertisement category, advertisement length, and whether the interaction occurred.

The data was collected through observational logging.

Where Were the Advertisements Seen?

A horizontal bar graph displaying observed number of advertisements per platform with Instagram as the most, followed by Facebook, Youtube, Google, and Other

Quick Explanation:

This graph shows that Instagram has the most number of advertisement observations at just over 20, followed by Facebook (Meta), Youtube, Google, and Other.

What Day of the Week had the Most Advertisements Observed?

Quick Explanation:

This graph shows that Monday has the most number of advertisements logged, with Wednesday and Friday having about the same, up from Tuesday and Saturday with 1 observation, and Thursday and Sunday having no observations.

Does Advertisement Length Influence Interaction?

Quick Explanation:

This graph shows that both medians are within the IQR of each other, but Interactions having a lower median then no interactions. Overall, nothing statistically significant.

What Advertisement Category had the Highest Interaction Rate?

Quick Explanation:

This graph shows that the interaction rate for Job Search advertisements is higher than others at just over 75%, possibly reflecting the fact that I am graduating this year and looking for jobs!
